content.outro: The thing on the flat has been walked, inside and along its back.
content.premise: A body the size of a hill lies beached on a mud flat in a valley floor. A wound in its flank lets a party in, two rooms inside it hold their own light, and a stair cut up its other flank leads onto its back.
content.theme: A stranded creature a hundred and forty blocks long, sunk to its belly in mud: dark leathery hide, a head laid on the flat, a long tail ending in flukes, and white ribs bursting from a wound in its flank.
content.title: The Beached Thing
